bio_en: Hovhannes Zakarbabian was a young ARF operative respected among his comrades for his daring. His most notable act was the killing of Grozdov, a spy of the Russian government who had for years ruined the Lori region and caused the arrest of many revolutionaries. Carrying out the ARF Central Committee's death sentence, he was pursued by guards and soldiers through the streets of Tiflis and fought until his ammunition ran out. He was shot dead on 21 December 1906.
